pictures.scene: Harmen Steenwijck, Vanitas Still-Life — the just-extinguished lamp with its thread of smoke rising beside the skull, for my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers
pictures.name: pd_steenwijck_rook

pictures.scene: Fra Juan Sánchez Cotán, Still Life with Quince, Cabbage, Melon and Cucumber — the food hanging untouched in the dark window, my heart is afflicted and withered like grass, I even forget to eat my bread
pictures.name: pd_cotan_brood

pictures.scene: Jusepe de Ribera, Saint Jerome and the Angel of Judgment — the old hermit's ribs showing under his skin as he starts up, through my loud groaning, my skin hangs on my bones
pictures.name: pd_ribera_beenderen

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, The Ruins of Eldena — the roofless gothic abbey standing open to the sky, I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_puinhopen

pictures.scene: Carel Fabritius, The Goldfinch — one small bird chained to its perch against a bare wall, I lie awake, I am like a lone bird on a housetop
pictures.name: pd_fabritius_vogel

pictures.scene: Anthony van Dyck, The Crowning with Thorns — Christ seated while the soldiers mock Him and lower the crown, all day long my enemies taunt me, they ridicule me and curse me
pictures.name: pd_dyck_spotten

pictures.scene: Rogier van der Weyden, The Descent from the Cross — the Magdalene with her hands wrung together and a tear on her cheek, for I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears
pictures.name: pd_weyden_tranen

pictures.scene: Gerard Seghers, The Denial of Saint Peter — Peter turning away from the coal fire with a tear on his face, because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have picked me up and cast me aside
pictures.name: pd_seghers_kolen

pictures.scene: Sanford Robinson Gifford, A Gorge in the Mountains (Kauterskill Clove) — the long golden light of late afternoon filling the whole valley, my days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass
pictures.name: pd_gifford_schaduw

pictures.scene: Pieter Jansz. Saenredam, Interior of the Church of St Odulphus at Assendelft — the white nave rising high above the grave slabs in the floor, but You O LORD sit enthroned forever, Your renown endures to all generations
pictures.name: pd_saenredam_troon

lines.text: For my days vanish like smoke,
and my bones burn like glowing embers.
My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass;
I even forget to eat my bread.
Through my loud groaning
my skin hangs on my bones.
I am like a desert owl,
like an owl among the ruins.
I lie awake;
I am like a lone bird on a housetop.
All day long my enemies taunt me;
they ridicule me and curse me.
For I have eaten ashes like bread
and mixed my drink with tears
because of Your indignation and wrath,
for You have picked me up and cast me aside.
My days are like lengthening shadows,
and I wither away like grass.
But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever;
Your renown endures to all generations.
